page.layout: One page of text, single column; title block centred at top, dedication lines below, then a paragraph opening with a woodcut initial M at left.

main_text.head: PRÆFATIO AD VIROS Reverendos ac Consultissimos.
main_text.p: D. Regnerum Hachtingium, D. Johannem Janssonium, D. Bartholdum Wiarda, Verbi Divini Ministros.
D. Douvonem Mellinga, I.V. Doct. & Advoc.
Irabimini forsan, neque immeritò, Metaphysicam à me, non tantum privatis, sed & publicis institutionibus adornari, ut quem novistis animo maximè ab hoc studio, cum sub Clariss. Præceptore

page.notes: The initial M is a large woodcut letter, transcribed as M joined to "Irabimini" in the first line of the paragraph. The catchword "ceptore" is given at the foot; the last line of the paragraph repeats it, so the catchword was retained only in bottom_margin. Faint marks and a small printed line at the very bottom right are not transcribed. The page carries no printed page number or running head.
